en.headline: John Lee meets AIIB President Zou Jiayi ahead of APEC finance meeting
en.dek: The Chief Executive welcomed the bank chief to Hong Kong and discussed stronger regional financial co-operation and support for an AIIB office in the city.
body: Chief Executive John Lee met Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank President Zou Jiayi at Government House on Monday to exchange views on further strengthening regional financial co-operation.

Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui also attended. Mr Lee welcomed Ms Zou and her delegation for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Finance Ministers' Meeting 2026, which begins on Tuesday in Hong Kong.

Mr Lee said Hong Kong, as an AIIB member and leading international financial centre, would continue to support the bank's work, including project financing and bond issuance. He expressed support for the AIIB establishing an office in the city that would serve financing and operational functions, and said the government would fully back the effort.

zh.headline: 李家超禮賓府會晤亞投行行長鄒加怡 歡迎出席APEC財長會議
zh.dek: 行政長官歡迎鄒加怡率團來港，雙方就加強區域金融合作交流，並全力支持亞投行在港設立辦事處。
body: 行政長官李家超周一在禮賓府與亞洲基礎設施投資銀行行長鄒加怡會面，就進一步加強區域金融合作交換意見。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇亦有出席。
李家超歡迎鄒加怡及代表團來港出席周二起一連兩日舉行的2026年亞太經濟合作組織財政部長會議。他表示香港作為亞投行成員及國際金融中心，將繼續支持亞投行在項目融資、發債等方面的工作。
李家超指樂意見到亞投行即將在港設立兼具融資及運作功能的辦事處，特區政府會全力支持有關籌備，並期望雙方繼續在過渡金融、科技創新及人才發展等領域加強合作。
